mapper.select: SELECT ta.id, ta.tenant_id, ta.alert_type, ta.target_id, ta.target_name, ta.timeout_level, ta.timeout_duration, ta.threshold, ta.assignee_id, ta.assignee_name, ta.alert_time, ta.notification_sent, ta.escalated, ta.escalated_to_id, ta.escalated_to_name, ta.escalated_time, ta.resolved, ta.resolved_by_id, ta.resolved_by_name, ta.resolve_note, ta.resolve_time, ta.create_time, ta.update_time FROM wf_timeout_alert ta WHERE ta.id = #{id}

SELECT ta.id, ta.tenant_id, ta.alert_type, ta.target_id, ta.target_name, ta.timeout_level, ta.timeout_duration, ta.threshold, ta.assignee_id, ta.assignee_name, ta.alert_time, ta.notification_sent, ta.escalated, ta.escalated_to_id, ta.escalated_to_name, ta.escalated_time, ta.resolved, ta.resolved_by_id, ta.resolved_by_name, ta.resolve_note, ta.resolve_time, ta.create_time, ta.update_time FROM wf_timeout_alert ta WHERE ta.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (ta.resolved = 'N' OR ta.resolved IS NULL) ORDER BY ta.alert_time DESC

SELECT ta.id, ta.tenant_id, ta.alert_type, ta.target_id, ta.target_name, ta.timeout_level, ta.timeout_duration, ta.threshold, ta.assignee_id, ta.assignee_name, ta.alert_time, ta.notification_sent, ta.escalated, ta.escalated_to_id, ta.escalated_to_name, ta.escalated_time, ta.resolved, ta.resolved_by_id, ta.resolved_by_name, ta.resolve_note, ta.resolve_time, ta.create_time, ta.update_time FROM wf_timeout_alert ta WHERE ta.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ta.timeout_level = #{level} ORDER BY ta.alert_time DESC

SELECT ta.id, ta.tenant_id, ta.alert_type, ta.target_id, ta.target_name, ta.timeout_level, ta.timeout_duration, ta.threshold, ta.assignee_id, ta.assignee_name, ta.alert_time, ta.notification_sent, ta.escalated, ta.escalated_to_id, ta.escalated_to_name, ta.escalated_time, ta.resolved, ta.resolved_by_id, ta.resolved_by_name, ta.resolve_note, ta.resolve_time, ta.create_time, ta.update_time FROM wf_timeout_alert ta WHERE ta.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ta.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} ORDER BY ta.alert_time DESC
